context_branches.topic: Draft identity, repeated first-line exercise and owner preservation
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: REPORT.WKB is supplied first draft, separate from earlier learner OUTLINE. Step3 covers every remaining paragraph first line but excludes titles and the existing table. Source does not enumerate paragraph count, so no finite per-paragraph case count is invented. Optional Reveal Codes must preserve beginning-of-line owners; vertical moves try to preserve horizontal cursor position.

context_branches.topic: Temporary paragraph margins versus literal tabs
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: A leading Tab affects only first line; F4 left Indent moves all wrapped paragraph lines to next stop. Backspace removes that owner before Shift+F4 bilateral Indent; two quotation paragraphs each receive another bilateral indent, adding half inch at each side. Enter ends temporary paragraph margin; no equivalent chain of literal tabs or permanent margin edits is inferred.

context_branches.topic: WB19 later indent notice
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: WBC51 notice3 records12/90 corrections to steps4,6,10: F4 for left indent and Shift+F4 for both margins. Original arrow-decorated labels are visually read as native indent icons and kept separate from later wording. No executable observation.

context_branches.topic: Persistent spacing and three repeated exceptions
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Set1.5 at report beginning; for two quotation paragraphs and Operating Expenses table set1 at beginning and1.5 after last line. These are three distinct target regions within numbered step8, each needing both boundary owners. Table begins at its title; preserving paragraph indent and surrounding spacing is part of the branch.

context_branches.topic: Underline state, selected tabs and local reset alternative
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Underline selected column-title line initially affects words/spaces but not tabs. Set Underline Spaces/Tabs at document beginning, retaining spaces Yes and choosing tabs Yes. Document-wide owner then affects all later underlined tabs. Optional table-only setup would add before/after owners; no exact reset keystrokes are supplied. Left-drag selection and Font/Appearance/Underline are separate routes.

context_branches.topic: Preview, first learner save and persistent versus paragraph formats
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Page through View Document, exit preview, save learner REPORT and stay in application with cleared screen. Original REPORT.WKB stays distinct. Prose contrasts paragraph-ending Indent with persistent Line Spacing; exact output pagination depends on draft, resource metrics and all prior edits.

context_branches.topic: Contradictory introductory illustration order
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Initial examples printed191/192/196 show Mail Order then Retail, while numbered input printed192–194 creates Retail then Mail Order; column-swap exercise later intentionally changes order. WBC51 notices1683/2079 reverse early screenshots/title, but1683 declares pages186–187 and2079page191. Keep notice page claims and actual1989 locators separate; do not globally reverse all illustrations or future inputs.

context_branches.topic: Tab ruler formats, decimal input and dot leader
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Clear existing stops, add relative3/5in and change both L to D; period marks first D as leader. Left/Center/Right/Decimal are visible options; Center and Flush Right/Tab Align command analogy does not execute every format. During typing digits move left until decimal point; leader is generated from tab definition rather than typed periods.

context_branches.topic: Complete guided quarter-row exercise

Insert new definition after final data line; clear ruler;0,.5 restores half-inch interval from margin; later paragraph becomes normal Tab again. Absolute ruler removes signs and starts at page0; absolute title stops remain fixed when left margin changes, relative data stops move. Numeric examples require font/printer metrics and exact table input.
